paragraphs: Find the work phone number for a single person. How It Works Provide the person's LinkedIn profile URL (linkedin_url) and we'll find their work phone. You can also pass a known email if you have one. Presets Preset Cost Success Rate Description basic_new 15.0 credits ~45% Faster, lower-cost lookup. premium 30.0 credits ~60% Broader, multi-source lookup. Higher hit rate. Pricing You are only charged when a phone is found. Phone not found = 0 credits.
